subtitle: Two chapters and an appendix under the guide profile
description: A fixture for check-book.sh's guide profile. Everything in it is a construct the narration profile rejects: an H3 inside a part, all four callout labels, a numbered procedure, a chapter opening on no handoff noun, and an appendix tagged [A1-n].
`guide-under-narration/` holds the same three files with the profile declaration removed. Running both is what shows the profile is doing the work rather than the checker having gone quiet.
